title: OCI repository settings
description: The oci member of a repository document. A member lists the classes it applies to in x-trove-classes; a member of another class is refused as not applicable. Local and virtual repositories have no settings of the format.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.description: What a mirror of the registry keeps: which tags and which platforms.

tags.title: Tags to mirror
tags.description: The tags to mirror, one pattern per line, where a star matches any text and a question mark one character. A tag named without a wildcard is always kept, whatever the number of versions per package.

excludeTags.title: Tags never mirrored
excludeTags.description: Tags never to mirror, even when they match a tag to mirror; the same wildcards apply.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: The platforms to keep of a multi-platform image, such as linux/amd64 or linux/arm64/v8. Leave it empty to keep every platform.
